sendAnonymousTelemetry.description: Send anonymous daily/hourly activity and native crash reports. Activity events contain no user content. Crash reports include process/stack state and limited memory around crashing threads, which can contain in-memory content fragments.

keybindings.description: VS Code-compatible keybinding rules, evaluated from bottom to top.

key.description: One key chord, or two chords separated by a space. Scan-code keys such as [Slash] are accepted.

command.description: A cmux command ID. Prefix with - to remove a matching default; use an empty string to consume the key without an action.

when.description: Conditional expression over cmux context keys.

args.description: JSON arguments passed to the command.
